parameters.name: APIEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable TerminalLocation API exposure on FAP

parameters.name: QueueEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable Request queueing for the API

parameters.name: Queueing
parameters.description: Determines how FAP handles simultaneous requests from different Applications to TerminalLocation API.

parameters.name: MaxAPIUsersNumber
parameters.description: Determines the Max Number of different Applications that can send Requests to TerminalLocation API.

parameters.name: QueryMobileLocationResponseAddress
parameters.description: Specifies Terminal Address Format to be used in QueryMobileLocation Responses.

parameters.name: QueryMobileLocationResponseLongitudeLatitude
parameters.description: Include or exclude FAP Longitude and Latitude arguments in Responses to QueryMobileLocation Requests.

parameters.name: QueryMobileLocationResponseAltitude
parameters.description: Include or exclude FAP Altitude argument in Responses to QueryMobileLocation Requests .

object.description: This object contains parameters related to the TerminalLocation API.
